summary_zh: LocalThings 是 Home Assistant 集成，可在家庭局域网内控制三星洗衣机、烘干机、冰箱、空调、烤箱等 SmartThings 家电，无需云端账号；多数家电只需输入 IP 地址即可完成设置并生成对应控制与传感器，支持推送更新和定时轮询。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Home Assistant、希望以本地网络方式接入并控制三星 SmartThings 家电的用户，尤其是关注数据留在本地、不希望依赖云账号的家庭自动化爱好者；部分较老机型或电视需额外凭据。

evidence.quote: Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account.

LocalThings connects Home Assistant to Samsung washers, dryers, refrigerators, air conditioners, ovens and other appliances that work with the SmartThings app. It talks to each appliance on your local network.
- **Setup needs an IP address.** For most appliances, you enter the address and LocalThings works out the type and model, then creates matching controls and sensors.
